summary: Amneal Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a debt repricing amendment. Its subsidiary, Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, converted $2.039 billion of existing term loans into new loans on a cashless basis and incurred an additional $45.2 million term loan to prepay non-converted loans. The interest rate margin was reduced by 50 basis points to 1.50% (base rate) and 2.50% (SOFR), with annualized cash interest savings estimated at $12 million. Maturity remains August 1, 2032. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
